# IndexOf

Finds the position of the first occurrence of a piece of text in a string, or of a value in an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
IndexOf(source, value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | any | The string or array to search. Null holds nothing. A boolean, a number, an object or a function is a runtime error. |
| `value` | any | What to look for. In an array, any value, null included, found at the first element equal to it by value. In a string, a string found by exact match, case included; null is found in no string, and any other type is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The position of the first match, counted from 0: in UTF-16 code units for a string, in elements for an array. -1 when value is not found, or when source is null. A whole number, exact. Never null.

## Example

`IndexOf("banana", "na")` returns 2.

`IndexOf([10, 20, 30], 30)` returns 2.

`IndexOf([1, 2], 5)` returns -1.
